quote:
The sea obeys its own rhythm, though the hawks above may stir ripples that urge ships on a hidden wind.

Even when a homeland is devoured by flames, a single ember can keep the heart of a thousand warriors beating.

Seeking kingdoms of coin is like wandering through a labyrinth of clever hands; oft the wanderer finds only the echo of her own footsteps.

Storms may bruise the earth, yet the mind can keep a quiet garden thriving beneath the wildest winds.

Mirrors reveal the faces of unseen kings, teaching that the most potent power lies in thoughts stepping beyond shadows.

When a blade severs silent words, the ancient craft that cut stone continues to echo in the voices that rise after the cut.

Thunder on earth may break with a fallen wing, but the sky reminds us that every journey must harmonize intent with the imperfections that follow.
